educationalGoal:
学習・教育目標
In Asian Studies, students will learn about various Asian cultures in English. It
is a reading course where students can expect to
1)	learn new vocabulary
2)	be able to understand and summarize short reading passages
3)	think critically about a text
4)	express their own opinions about a text
advice:
Students will learn about various Asian cultures through short reading materials. The course is based on the tex
tbook Asian Issues 1.

The themes of the course include Asian cultures, cities, food, and entertainment. Students will have 10 homework
 assignments and there will be 2 speaking tests (week 7 and week 14).

The general layout of a class includes reading and understanding a short text, being able to think critically ab
out it, and then expressing an opinion about the text.

Students who take the course can expect to develop their reading skills and also practice expressing their opini
on about a particular topic.
